invariants.event_uniqueness_order: events are unique and monotonically ordered by (run_id, sequence_no)
invariants.scoped_idempotency_uniqueness: idempotency is unique for run_id, actor_type, actor_id, idempotency_key
invariants.state_version_concurrency: commands compare expected_state_version before mutation and state_version is non-negative
invariants.append_only_events: persisted events cannot be updated or deleted
invariants.tool_operation_states: operation status follows PENDING -> DISPATCHED -> SUCCEEDED|FAILED, with IN_DOUBT reconciliation
invariants.envelope_choreography_registry_reference: wire envelopes reference registered envelope and choreography IDs
invariants.approval_actions: approval actions bind plan hash, run, actor and expected state version
invariants.emergency_records: emergency records are independently latched and immutable

tables.name: runs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE runs (run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, state_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (state_version >= 0), status TEXT NOT NULL, latest_event_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (latest_event_sequence >= 0), emergency_latched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (emergency_latched IN (0,1)));

tables.name: events
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE events (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id), sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0), event_type TEXT NOT NULL, state_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (state_version >= 0), payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (run_id, sequence_no));

tables.name: idempotency_keys
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE idempotency_keys (run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id), actor_type TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, command_type TEXT NOT NULL, expected_state_version INTEGER CHECK (expected_state_version IS NULL OR expected_state_version >= 0), payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (run_id, actor_type, actor_id, idempotency_key));

tables.name: operation_records
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE operation_records (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id), mission_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_id TEXT NOT NULL, worker_id TEXT NOT NULL, idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','DISPATCHED','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','IN_DOUBT')), dispatch_recorded_at TEXT, reconciled_at TEXT);

tables.name: envelope_registry
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE envelope_registry (wire_type TEXT PRIMARY KEY, schema_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, contract_version TEXT NOT NULL);

tables.name: choreography_registry
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE choreography_registry (choreography_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, envelope_schema_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES envelope_registry(schema_id), enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (enabled IN (0,1)));

tables.name: approval_actions
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE approval_actions (action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id), plan_id TEXT NOT NULL, plan_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('CONFIRM','REJECT')), expected_state_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expected_state_version >= 0), created_at TEXT NOT NULL);

tables.name: emergency_records
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE emergency_records (signal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT REFERENCES runs(run_id), mission_id TEXT, worker_id TEXT NOT NULL, latched_at TEXT NOT NULL, source_kind TEXT NOT NULL, reason_code TEXT NOT NULL);

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER events_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER events_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER emergency_records_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON emergency_records BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'emergency records are immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER emergency_records_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON emergency_records BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'emergency records are immutable'); END;
